recording: Arcangelo Corelli, Sonata op. 3 Nr. 1, Grave. Ensemble Aurora, Enrico Gatti (Corelli: Sonate da chiesa opera terza & Sonate postume, 1998)
method: Anchors pair a score time in quarter notes from the start (data-on in the SVGs) with seconds into the track. They come from the 30-second previews, aligned to corelli-op3-1-grave.mei by dynamic time warping on chroma (the recording sounds a semitone low, a' = 415). Apple's preview starts at 0:00 and gives T. 1-4 directly. Spotify's and Deezer's previews give T. 7-10 among themselves; where they sit in the track was estimated from the tempo on either side (2 s per quarter). T. 5-6 and T. 11-19 are interpolated, with the last chord about 13 s before the end of the track. Blocks are bars measured among themselves: a correction made in the slides (shift-click a note while it sounds) moves a block as a whole and stretches what lies between.
